content: Koht pahn ketin Kaloke Sapwellime Imwintihti kan
Kumwail kohdo, kumwail tohn wehi koaros! Kumwail pokonpene oh rong. Sampah pwon oh aramas koaros me kin koukousoan loale en kohdo oh rong.
KAUN-O ketin engiengdahr pahn wehi koaros oh neirail karis kan. E ketin kerieiraillahr pwe re en mwomwla.
Paliwararail kan sohte pahn seridi, ahpw pahn wonohn wasao pwehn mwerpeseng oh matala; oh nahna kan pahn weitahtahkihla nta.

Ketipin, maram, oh usu kan pahn mwerpeseng wiahla pwelpar. Pahnlahng pahn sohrala rasehng pelien doaropwe ehu me limilimpene, oh usu kan pahn pwupwudi rasehng tehntuhke kan me pwumwpwupwudi sang nan tuhkehn wain de tuhke pik pwoat.
KAUN-O ketin kaunopadahr sapwellime kedlahs nanleng, eri, met e pahn ketin pelehki Edom, irail ko me e ketin kerialahr pwe re en mwomwla.

Sapwellime kedlahs pahn direkihla ntahrail oh wihrail, rasehng ntahn oh wih en sihmpwul oh kuht me kin wiahla mehn meirong. KAUN-O pahn ketin wia meirong wet nan kahnimw Posra; e pahn ketin wia lapalahn kamaramas ehu nan wehin Edom.
Aramas akan pahn pwupwudi mehla rasehng kou lawalo oh koupwul kan, oh sampah pahn weitahtahkihla nta oh wih kan.
Ih ahnsowo met me KAUN-O pahn ketin kapitala Saion oh kalowehdi eh imwintihti kan.
Pillap akan en Edom pahn wiahla tahr oh pwehlo pahn wiahla suwepel okohk. Sahpwo pwon pahn luluda rasehng tahr.
E pahn wie lullul nipwong nin rahn, oh ediediniei kohkohlahte. Sahpwo pahn tetehnla sang ehu dih lel ehu dih.
Likoht oh menpihr lawalo kan pahn sapwenikihla. KAUN-O pahn ketin pwurehng wiahkihla sapwtehn ehu, duwehte mwohn eh saikinte kapikipikda.
Sohte nanmwarki men me pahn kaunda sahpwo, oh kaun akan koaros pahn sohla mie.
Kisin tuhke tekatek oh dihpw kan pahn wosada nan tehnpas akan koaros oh ni kelen kisin kahnimw kan, oh mahn lawalo oh likoht kan pahn kousoanla ie.
Mahn lawalo kan pahn kohkohseli wasa pwuko, oh eni kan pahn kin likwerpene nanpwungarail. Eni wos lih
emen pahn kin kohdo wasao pwehn rapahki wasahn eh kommoal.
Likoht kan pahn wiahda pasarail kan, kutoahredi oh kasawahdi, oh apwalihada wahrail kan wasao. Puldur kan pahn kohkohpene oh kousoanla wasao.

Kumwail rapahki nan sapwellimen KAUN-O pwuken mahn mour kan oh dahme pwuhko koasoia. Sohte emen rehn mahn pwukat me sohte pahn iang kousoan wasao, oh sohte emen me eh werek sohte pahn iang mi wasao. KAUN-O ketin koasoanedier pwe mepwukat en pweida; pein ih me pahn ketikinirailpene.
Iei Koht me pahn ketin nehkpeseng sahpwo nanpwungarail oh ketikihong pweisen emenemen. Re pahn kousoan nan sahpwo sang ehu dih lel ehu dih, oh e pahn wiahla sapwarail kohkohlahte.

footnotes.text: ENI WOS LIH: Eni lih emen, me aramas akan kin kamehlele me e kin kousoan nan sapwtehn.
